name: CSV to SQL INSERT Bulk
summary: Convert large CSV files into batched SQL INSERT statements with optional transactions.
description: Paste CSV data and generate bulk INSERT statements with configurable batch size (default 100 rows per statement), dialect-specific quoting, optional BEGIN/COMMIT wrapper, and TRUNCATE prefix for reload workflows.

faqs.question: How is this different from CSV to SQL INSERT?
faqs.answer: This tool defaults to larger batches and adds transaction wrapping and TRUNCATE options for bulk data loads.

faqs.question: Which databases are supported?
faqs.answer: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and SQL Server quoting styles are available.
